g.text: Multi-tenant fleet operations. Phase 1 ships the admin web app on Spring Boot + PostgreSQL with tenant isolation enforced in the database.
Edge — Nginx · TLS termination · static assets · rate limiting
API · Spring Boot 3.3 · Java 21 · REST /api · OpenAPI / Swagger
Spring Security + JWT (15 min access · 7 day refresh) · TenantFilter → SET LOCAL app.tenant_id
Object storage — rider documents, chassis photos Phase 2
